title: DNA Extraction Using Zymo Research Quick-DNA Fecal/Soil Microbe Kit
author: Jenna Brown

steps.title: Add soil to bead tube
steps.instruction: Add 5 g of soil sample to the bead/filter of a ZR Bashing Bead Lysis/Filtration Tube (50 mL, 0.5 mm beads; Cat #: S6010).

steps.title: Add BashingBead Buffer and seal
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL of BashingBead Buffer (Cat #: D6001-3-150) to the tube, cap tightly, and secure with parafilm.

steps.title: Bead‑beating
steps.instruction: Place the tube sideways in a Bullet Blender bead beater, select the “Zymo MidiPrep” protocol, and run for 10 min at speed 8. Store tubes sideways until loading to prevent premature liquid flow through filter.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the ZR BashingBead Lysis/Filtration Tube at 5000 rpm, °C, for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the bead/filter chamber from the top of the tube, and using a 10 mL pipette transfer the supernatant from the bottom to a new 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Add Genomic Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 18 mL of Genomic Lysis Buffer to the supernatant and mix well. If excessive foam forms, centrifuge briefly for a few seconds.

steps.title: Vacuum filter mixture
steps.instruction: Filter the entire mixture through a Zymo‑Spin V‑E Column/Zymo‑Midi Filter (Cat #: C1021-25) mounted on a vacuum manifold at ≥600 mm Hg.

steps.title: Spin column in collection tube
steps.instruction: Disconnect the column, place it into a Collection Tube (Cat #: C1001-50), and spin at 10 000 rpm, °C, for 1 min in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: DNA Pre‑Wash
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL DNA Pre‑Wash Buffer (Cat #: D3004-5-15) to the column, spin at 10 000 rpm, °C, for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through. Add reagent by inserting the pipette tip at an angle against the column wall without touching the filter to avoid overflow.

steps.title: g‑DNA Wash
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL g‑DNA Wash Buffer (Cat #: D3004-2-50) to the column, centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, °C, for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 150 µL DNA Elution Buffer (Cat #: D3004-4-16) directly onto the matrix, wait 1 min, then centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, °C, for 1 min to collect eluate.

steps.title: Prep Zymo‑Spin III‑HCR filter
steps.instruction: Place a Zymo‑Spin III‑HCR Filter in a clean Collection Tube, add 600 µL Prep Solution (Cat #: D6035-1-30), and centrifuge at 8000 rpm, °C, for 3 min.

steps.title: Filter eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Place the same Zymo‑Spin III‑HCR Filter in a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, transfer the eluted DNA onto the filter, and centrifuge at exactly 16 000 rpm, °C, for 3 min. The filtered DNA is now ready for PCR and downstream applications.

steps.title: Add β‑mercaptoethanol
steps.instruction: Add β‑mercaptoethanol (not supplied) to the Genomic Lysis Buffer (Cat #: D3004-1-100) to a final concentration of 0.5 % (v/v) (2.5 mL per 500 mL) for optimal performance.

steps.title: Repeat g‑DNA Wash
steps.instruction: Add another 400 µL g‑DNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, °C, for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.
